verdict.verdict_one_line: AGAINST the paper's current freeze-bar: the level-crossing theta* is not a measured crossover load (its value moves 6.1-fold across the reported level conventions at s_d = 0.01, 1.21 -> 0.20), whereas two convention-free descriptors -- the half-drop of the log-median fixation-time curve (theta*_half = 0.54 [0.45, 0.66] at s_d = 0.01) and the chi_late departure load (0.45 [0.35, 0.55]) -- agree with each other within CI; the level-0.5 ridge (0.37) sits below the half-drop interval and no single reported level (0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75) coincides with the invariant, whose equivalent level runs from 0.29 to 0.48 across s_d and descriptors.

task: Round-10: convention-independent crossover descriptors (T3 cluster 1) from deposited data only
bootstrap_scheme: run-level: runs resampled with replacement within every load rung; whole gap trajectories resampled for chi; one shared neutral-anchor draw per replicate

definitions.half_drop_endpoint: theta at which log10(median T_fix) has fallen halfway between its lowest-sampled-load and highest-sampled-load values (first descending crossing, linear interp in log10 theta)
definitions.half_drop_neutral_normalised: as above but the low-load reference is log10 of the pooled kind=='neutral' median T_fix (theta -> 0 anchor)
definitions.half_drop_common_range: as endpoint half-drop but every rung restricted to the shared load window [0.1, 1.2] (endpoint medians interpolated in log-load)
definitions.half_drop_isotonic: endpoint half-drop after weighted PAVA (weights = runs per rung) on the log-medians (robustness to non-monotone rungs)
definitions.inflection_4pl: weighted 4PL in log-load, y = L + (U-L)/(1+10^{h(x-c)}); theta50 = 10^c; plateau reached if the fitted curve at the sampled endpoint is within 5% of the drop (U-L) of the asymptote
definitions.chi_late: OLS slope of log10 Var_alive[g] vs log10 t over the terminal fraction f of the retained log-time span (grid frames = grid_mult*500, retained when n_alive >= 30); f in [0.2, 0.3333333333333333, 0.5]
definitions.chi_frozen_reference: inverse-variance-weighted mean of chi_late over the 3 lowest sampled loads (theta = 0.05, 0.10, 0.15); the neutral ensemble carries no fitness gap (g == 0), so a neutral chi is undefined and the frozen-interface floor of the loaded ladder is the reference
definitions.chi_departure_rule: smallest sampled load theta_i (above the reference rungs) such that z_j = (chi_j - chi_frozen)/sqrt(SE_j^2 + SE_frozen^2) >= 2 for j = i and for EVERY higher sampled load (sustained exceedance); reported as bracket (theta_{i-1}, theta_i] and its geometric midpoint; z >= 3 tabulated as sensitivity
definitions.chi_half_rise: load at which chi_late (piecewise-linear in log-load through the rung values) first rises through the midpoint of its lowest-load and highest-load values (mirror image of the T_fix half-drop; no threshold parameter)
